title.value: Bugs in Machine Learning-based Systems: A Faultload Benchmark
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Bugs in Machine Learning-based Systems: A Faultload Benchmark

extractions.description: The paper introduces defect4ML, a faultload benchmark of bugs in ML-based systems, to assess testing tools and techniques. It investigates the reproducibility and verifiability of bugs in ML-based systems, providing a benchmark with 100 bugs reported by ML developers in GitHub and Stack Overflow, using TensorFlow and Keras.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on software reliability and testing within ML systems, not directly on sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The rapid escalation of applying Machine Learning (ML) in various domains has led to paying more attention to the quality of ML components.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not directly address any of the listed Sustainable Development Goals.
primary_category.quote: The paper is about software reliability engineering for ML-based systems, not directly related to environmental sustainability or climate action.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's focus is on improving the reliability of ML software through bug detection and benchmarking, which is not directly related to any specific subcategory.
primary_sub_category.quote: The study focuses on software reliability engineering of ML-based systems and the creation of a bug benchmark for testing tools, not on specific Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development subcategories.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper doesn't fit into any of the existing categories, and it doesn't strongly suggest a new category related to sustainable development.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper doesn't fit into any of the existing subcategories, and it doesn't strongly suggest a new subcategory related to sustainable development.
